summary: Frontend-only validation of GMC iteration_3 Polish Round (circular InsurerMark system, comparing strip cleanup, rail popover improvements, exact filter toggle spec 38x22, Ask launch bubble, FeatureIcon integration in At-a-Glance/Full Comparison/DetailModal). 100% of user-visible acceptance criteria PASS across desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844). No page errors captured. Only one minor Radix a11y console warning (DialogDescription missing) — not a regression from iteration_2.

issues: Radix DialogContent emits console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined}'. Add a visually-hidden <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to the DialogContent. Cosmetic/a11y-only; not a regression from iteration_2.

Inline style border is '1.5px solid <accent>' but Chromium rounds computed border-width to 1px (subpixel snapping). Visually fine, but if a truly 1.5px stroke is desired use box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px <accent> instead of border. Very minor.

action_items: (Optional) Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to DetailModal DialogContent to silence Radix a11y warning.
(Optional) If a strict 1.5px chip border is required, use box-shadow inset instead of the border shorthand (browsers snap sub-2px borders).
critical_code_review_comments: InsurerMark.jsx: rock-solid; two-mode rendering (image vs initials) driven by MARK_IDS set. Consider promoting MARK_IDS or the whole mapping into gmc_tool_data.json so brand ops can add insurers without a code change.

ControlDock.jsx (285 lines): renders the RailPickerGrid inline. Could be extracted into its own file for testability, but not urgent. The onClick + Popover controlled-state pair correctly wires toggle-to-close without breaking click-away.
AskLaunchBubble.jsx: uses inline style + `transform: translateY(120%)` for hidden state. Good — avoids unmounting the bubble so animation is smooth when a DetailModal closes.

FeatureIcon.jsx: startsWith fallback is elegant. However some AtAGlance titles include qualifiers like 'GP / day-to-day add-on' which is caught by 'gp / day-to-day' key. Good. Consider a unit test to lock the mapping.
DetailModal.jsx & MobileSheet.jsx: DialogContent lacks aria-describedby — see design_issues.
InsurerStrip.jsx: `boxShadow: 0 4px 12px -8px ${accent}` produces a subtle brand-tinted glow — nice touch.
index.css .gmc-toggle: !important guards against .gmc-tap min-w/h. Confirmed 38x22 with 16x16 thumb at 3px offset (verified via getBoundingClientRect + ::after pseudo).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static React app — REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is the site URL only. Landing / is the compare page. Insurer IDs in data are: sc, nib, aia, pl (Partners Life), uni (UniMed). The request naming ('partners' / 'unimed') refers to the same insurers — use testids insurer-mark-pl and insurer-mark-uni. Marks: sc/nib/aia render as PNG images from /logos/marks/{id}.png; pl and uni render as insurer.accent-coloured circles with white initials (PL = 'PL', UniMed = 'U'). Note: pl's accent is dark green rgb(29,74,68) per data — the review request called it 'burgundy' but the code correctly uses whatever is in the JSON. Selection toggle in ComparePage refuses to drop below 2 insurers, so to select PL/UniMed you must first select a 3rd (e.g. aia) rather than trying to swap when at length 2. To verify PL/UniMed marks, open the rail picker popover and inspect [data-testid='insurer-mark-pl'] / [data-testid='insurer-mark-uni'] inside their rail-insurer-* cards.
